frontend: Angular comparison page uses GraphQL with aliased queries
Static content delivered via a CDN
backend: Queueing system for long-running tasks like sending emails and generating PDFs
Application caching for most data retrieval functionalities
apis: RESTful API exposed by Laravel back-end
GraphQL API exposed by Laravel back-end
Lighthouse / nuwave/lighthouse schema-first GraphQL server for Laravel
GraphQL supports queries, mutations, JWT-guarded fields via @guard, and relationship eager-loading via @belongsTo / @hasMany
databases: MySQL database with migration and seeding scripts
testing: MailHog for testing emails in local deployment
infrastructure: Nginx 1.23 Alpine reverse proxy for API
Docker services include laravel-api, angular-ui, web, mariadb, composer, mailcatcher, phpmyadmin
